why_best: Widening the scope from a single micro-datum to the macro dashboard creates an instant insight that re-anchors the viewer's understanding of the tool.
why_bad: A hard transition or step-by-step fade would break the narrative continuity, treating the context as separate information rather than the organic environment of the hero figure.
trap: Exposing the surrounding structure too early spoils the narrative payload before the focal metric can establish its initial weight.
